jobs.title: Software Engineer – Winter Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Quick answer: Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 is open for three onsite intern roles at Rubrik’s Bangalore office: Software Engineer, Software Engineer (CPD) and ENG Project/Program Intern. All three need a CGPA of 8 or more, a 2027 graduation year in a circuital branch, and full-time availability from January to May 2027. Stipend is not published.

Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 — job details at a glance Company Rubrik, Inc. (NYSE: RBRK) Roles Software Engineer – Winter Intern (8166523) · Software Engineer (CPD) – Winter Intern (8166537) · ENG Project/Program – Intern (8166514) Location Bangalore (Bengaluru), onsite – no remote option Duration January 2027 to May 2027 Batch 2027 graduates only Branches Circuital branches only (CSE, IT, ECE, EEE and similar) Minimum CGPA 8.0 and above Stipend Official: Not disclosed | Reported: ₹1–1.8 lakh per month (Indian job-board listings, unverified) Selection process Not published by Rubrik Status All three roles open on Rubrik’s Greenhouse board (re-checked 21 Nov 2026) Software Engineer – Winter InternJob ID 8166523 · ApplySoftware Engineer (CPD) – Winter InternJob ID 8166537 · ApplyENG Project/Program – InternJob ID 8166514 · Apply

Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 – full job details

The Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 cycle covers three separate openings, each with its own application. Two are core engineering seats, one on a product team and one in Continuous Product Development (CPD), the group that owns mature Rubrik products end to end. The third is a programme management seat inside the engineering organisation.

Every Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 role is based in Bangalore and runs for roughly five months starting January 2027. Rubrik builds data security and cyber-recovery software, so interns work on real storage, backup and cloud code rather than demo projects. You can apply to more than one role if your profile fits each of them.

Four hard filters apply to every role: CGPA 8.0 or above, graduating in 2027, circuital branch only, and available onsite in Bangalore from January to May 2027. If you miss any one of these, your application is unlikely to be considered.

Rubrik has not published the stipend, the number of seats or a closing date. Treat the “reported” stipend below as a market estimate, not an offer.

What you will do in the Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 role

Software Engineer and Software Engineer (CPD) interns will:

  • Design, write, test and ship features in Rubrik’s product code
  • Find and fix performance bottlenecks in the software stack
  • Own the priorities and deadlines of an individual project
  • CPD interns focus on improving and maintaining established products end to end

ENG Project/Program interns in the Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 will:

  • Help define programme scope, milestones and success metrics
  • Maintain project plans, schedules and dashboards that track KPIs
  • Share status updates with engineering, product and support teams
  • Flag delivery risks early and help draft mitigation plans
  • Suggest tools that make delivery faster and capture lessons learned

Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 eligibility

  • Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science or a related field (Program role also accepts Engineering or Information Systems)
  • Batch: 2027 graduates only
  • Branch: circuital branches only
  • CGPA: 8.0 and above
  • Coding (engineering roles): good command of at least one language such as Java, C/C++, Scala or Python
  • Program role: basic SDLC and agile knowledge, strong organisation and communication; AWS/Azure/GCP or storage exposure is a plus

Not confirmed by Rubrik: whether dual-degree students, backlogs or non-circuital minors are accepted. The JD is silent on these, so check with the recruiter before you assume either way.

Expected salary for the Rubrik Winter Internship 2027

Rubrik does not state the stipend. Indian job boards that carried earlier Rubrik winter intern listings show figures between ₹1 lakh and ₹1.8 lakh per month. AmbitionBox and Glassdoor have no India intern data for Rubrik yet, and Levels.fyi lists only US intern pay. Use these numbers as a rough guide and confirm the exact stipend in writing at offer stage.

Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 selection process

Rubrik has not published the Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 selection rounds. Based on how product companies usually hire interns, plan for this sequence:

  1. Resume shortlist against the CGPA, batch and branch filters
  2. Online coding test (data structures, algorithms, debugging)
  3. One or two technical interviews (coding plus systems or CS fundamentals)
  4. A final round with a manager; Program candidates should expect a case-style discussion on planning and risk

How to apply for Rubrik Winter Internship 2027

  1. Pick the role that suits you: Software Engineer – Winter Intern, Software Engineer (CPD) – Winter Intern or ENG Project/Program – Intern
  2. Click Apply on the Rubrik careers page and fill the Greenhouse form
  3. Upload your resume and enter your CGPA and graduation year exactly as on your mark sheet
  4. Submit and watch your email (including spam) for the test link

About Rubrik

Rubrik is a US-listed cybersecurity company focused on data security, identity and AI operations. Its platform helps enterprises protect backups, detect threats and recover quickly after attacks. Bangalore is one of its largest engineering centres, and many full-time offers come from its intern pool, which makes the Rubrik Winter Internship 2027 a strong entry point.
